reconciliation_with_documented_counts.reconciliation_explanation: The actual prepared dataset in data/processed/prepared contains 20,000 total rows (2,500 per class across 8 classes) generated by src/preprocessing/sample_data.py. The 9,022,524 raw / 9,014,734 retained row counts documented in prior logs reflect the dry-run estimation of full dataset files, whereas model training and testing were executed on the 20,000 synthetic sample rows.

split_methodology.assessment: Stratified random row-wise split on synthetic Gaussian data. In real network intrusion datasets (like CICIoT2023), row-wise splitting can cause temporal/session leakage. However, on this synthetic dataset, the synthetic generator itself induces linear separability across target classes.
